summary: Tested 3 new features: Intake Auto-Fill in Prescription Writer, Day-End Closing Modal, and Wait Time Estimator. All backend APIs pass. All frontend features pass after fixing a critical crash bug.

ui_bugs.issue: Page crashed with 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading split)' when appointments had null end_time. Fixed by adding null guard in formatTime().

critical_code_review_comments: formatTime() in /app/frontend/src/lib/utils.js had no null guard — calling timeString.split(':') on undefined crashed the Appointments page. Fixed: added 'if (!timeString) return ""' guard.

The intake prefill banner (intake-prefill-banner) correctly shows for appointments with pre_intake_status=auto_captured AND no existing notes. The notes field takes priority over pre_intake, which is correct behavior.
Day-end modal only triggers if all appointments are in terminal state (completed/no_show/cancelled) AND patients_seen > 0 — this is the correct and expected behavior.
Wait time chip correctly shows ~10 min wait for checked_in patients based on avg_consult_minutes=10.0 fallback.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 3 features verified: wait time chip (~10 min), day-end modal (patients seen, revenue, close button), intake prefill banner with dismiss
